newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes softer at 231.00/50 vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes softer at 231.00/50 vs dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 231.00-231.50 per dollar, versus 230.00-231.40 at the opening due to a rise in foreign currency demand amid a balanced interbank trade, dealers said.
"(Dollar) bids from an end customer at 231 levs pressured the lev in the afternoon," said a bank dealer.
Foreign currency supply came mainly from commercial banks as the centrral bank was not seen in the market. Central bank officials were not available for comment.
Dealers said the bulk of deals were struck at 231 levs per dollar with tomorrow's value date as spot trading was low.
Traders said trade was likely to be calm on Tuesday. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
